status: Pass 2: plausible detail (panel lines, access plates, intakes, drive, gun and canopy detail, sensors) on the pass-1 silhouette. No damage or textures.
units: One sprite pixel per unit about the .ship centre; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres

scale.summary: Single-seat torpedo bomber: forked twin-prong nose, offset port torpedo store, one centre-line drive
scale.method: Sized from the cockpit. The sprite's pale canopy patch is 6 units long on the waist; a single-seat canopy is 2.6-3.5 m long, so 0.43-0.58 m/unit. At 0.5 the canopy is 3.0 x 1.15 m at the sill, a seated 1.8 m pilot clears it by the reported margin, and the airframe is 16.4 m long and 12 m across the fins: the A-6 / Su-24 class of two-engine strike aircraft, the size a torpedo bomber carrying one heavy store should be. The port store comes out 0.95 m across and 5 m long with its seeker, heavyweight-torpedo proportions (Mk 48: 0.53 x 5.8 m); the 12-unit drive block is 6 m wide around a 3.2 m nozzle ring. Below 0.43 the canopy is shorter than any real single-seat canopy; above 0.58 it is longer than one, and the hull passes 19 m.

sprite.pixel_to_model: col c, row r (from top) covers X 17-r..18-r, Y 14-c..15-c

root.name: Dagger root
root.note: the .ship centre: the game's rotation pivot

anchor_convention: ARROWS empties; local +X points along the slot angle (0 = nose, 180 = aft)
notes: Sprite axis is Y = 0 (boundary of columns 14 and 15); the .ship centre column 15 counts from the left edge, so the fork, waist and drive block are symmetric about Y = 0 and only the wings differ.

The open notch between the prongs (|Y| < 1) is empty in the sprite down to X = 2, the cockpit body's front face. The master fills its lower half with a central spine and puts its canopy there; the sprite wins: the canopy sits on the waist (X -0.5..-6.5) under the sprite's pale centre patch.

Unequal wings as the sprite draws them: port pylon (Y 7..8) to a pod (Y 8..12) carrying the cream torpedo store, then a strut (Y 12..13) to a tip fin (Y 13..14); starboard a stub (Y -9..-6) to a tip fin (Y -10..-9).

WS 001 (ENERGY, HIDDEN, unfitted on dagger_Bomber) anchors on the cockpit body's front face at the notch root (2, 0). WS 002 (MISSILE, HIDDEN, atropos_single) anchors in the open notch at (7, 0); no launcher is modelled there because the sprite draws none. The visible ordnance is the painted port store, modelled as Weapon WS 002 port torpedo store on the port pod: presentation only, the game launches from (7, 0).

Engine slot (-13, 0), width 12: the 12-unit drive block (X -7..-15, |Y| <= 6) is the drive unit. Its bell sits on the block's aft face at X -15.15, 2.15 units aft of the slot, because the sprite closes the tail there; the Engine 1 centre exhaust anchor is at that mouth. No renderEngineOffsetsNativePx is listed for the Dagger.

Pass 2 (detail read off master-v2, sized in metres at 0.5 m/unit): each prong carries the master's slatted vent behind its tip, a small sensor blister ahead of it and seams at its tip cap and root. The unfitted WS 001 energy mount is a closed aperture (bright ring, dark iris) on the body's front face at the notch root. The canopy has a sill, windscreen arch and bow; the body the master's flank intakes and plate seams. The drive block carries the master's dorsal grille, a blade antenna, a collar rib ahead of the lip and a centre body with stator vanes in its bell. The cream store gets joint bands, cruciform tail fins, a seeker window and two sway braces to its pod; the fins and stub carry vents and seams.

silhouette.method: top render alpha vs sprite alpha (>127), nearest-sampled into the top camera frame at 37.09 px per unit
